title: 5개국 중고 의류 구매율 추세 (2018-2022)
fullPassage: The graph above shows the trends in second-hand clothing purchases in five countries from 2018 to 2022. In 2022, the United States recorded the highest percentage of respondents who bought second-hand clothes, maintaining the top position throughout the entire period. In 2018, the UK ranked second, while France and Germany shared the next highest percentage, but by 2022, France overtook the UK. France and Germany had the same percentage in 2018, but the gap between them gradually widened, reaching a difference of below 10 percentage points in 2022. Spain had the lowest percentage in 2018, at 12%, and although this figure rose to 16% in 2022, it still remained at only half the level of the United States. From 2018 and 2022, France showed the largest increase, while the United States saw the smallest rise, with only a 3-percentage-point difference.
